stratagems.name: Warpfire
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, on an unmodified Hit roll of 6, that attack has the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

stratagems.name: Traitor's Hatred
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Strength and Damage characteristics of melee weapons used by models in your unit.

stratagems.name: Corrupted Shields
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as a target.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the invulnerable save of models in your unit by 1 (to a maximum of 3+).
